versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם שְׁמַ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־הַחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י דֹּבֵ֥ר בְּאָזְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם וּלְמַדְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַעֲשֹׂתָֽם׃

controles.web: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears this day, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”
controles.kjv: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
controles.livre: E chamou Moisés a todo Israel, e disse-lhes: Ouve, Israel, os estatutos e regulamentos que eu pronuncio hoje em vossos ouvidos: e aprendei-os, e guardai-os, para praticá-los.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת עִמָּ֛נוּ בְּרִ֖ית בְּחֹרֵֽב׃

controles.web: Yahweh our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
controles.kjv: The Lord our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
controles.livre: O SENHOR nosso Deus fez pacto conosco em Horebe.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֣א אֶת־אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את כִּ֣י אִתָּ֗נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ אֵ֥לֶּה פֹ֛ה הַיּ֖וֹם כֻּלָּ֥נוּ חַיִּֽים׃

controles.web: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
controles.kjv: The Lord made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
controles.livre: Não com nossos pais fez o SENHOR este pacto, a não ser conosco todos os que estamos aqui hoje vivos.

versos.hebraico: פָּנִ֣ים׀ בְּפָנִ֗ים דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה עִמָּכֶ֛ם בָּהָ֖ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the midst of the fire,
controles.kjv: The Lord talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
controles.livre: Face a face falou o SENHOR convosco no monte do meio do fogo,

versos.hebraico: אָ֠נֹכִי עֹמֵ֨ד בֵּין־יְהוָ֤ה וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְהַגִּ֥יד לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י יְרֵאתֶם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ וְלֹֽא־עֲלִיתֶ֥ם בָּהָ֖ר לֵאמֹֽר׃ס

controles.web: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word: for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain;) saying,
controles.kjv: (I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to shew you the word of the Lord: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
controles.livre: (Eu estava então entre o SENHOR e vós, para vos anunciar a palavra do SENHOR; porque vós tivestes temor do fogo, e não subistes ao monte;) dizendo:

versos.hebraico: אָֽנֹכִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃

controles.web: “I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
controles.kjv: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
controles.livre: Eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, que te tirei da terra do Egito, de casa de servos.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֛ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עַל־פָּנָֽיַ׃

controles.web: “You shall have no other gods before me.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
controles.livre: Não terás deuses estranhos diante de mim.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽ֣א־תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְךָ֥ פֶ֨סֶל֙ כָּל־תְּמוּנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּמַּ֖יִם מִתַּ֥חַת לָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: “You shall not make an engraved image for yourself, any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
controles.livre: Não farás para ti escultura, nem imagem alguma de coisa que está acima nos céus, ou abaixo na terra, ou nas águas debaixo da terra:

versos.hebraico: לֹא־תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א תָעָבְדֵ֑ם כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵד עֲוֺ֨ן אָב֧וֹת עַל־בָּנִ֛ים וְעַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃

controles.web: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them; for I, Yahweh, your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me;
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
controles.livre: Não te inclinarás a elas nem lhes servirás: porque eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, forte, zeloso, que visito a iniquidade dos pais sobre os filhos, e sobre a terceira geração, e sobre a quarta, aos que me aborrecem,

versos.hebraico: וְעֹ֥שֶׂה חֶ֖סֶד לַֽאֲלָפִ֑ים לְאֹהֲבַ֖י וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מצותו׃ס

controles.web: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.
controles.kjv: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
controles.livre: E que faço misericórdia a milhares aos que me amam, e guardam meus mandamentos.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת־שֵֽׁם־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לַשָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ לַשָּֽׁוְא׃ס

controles.web: “You shall not take the name of Yahweh your God in vain: for Yahweh will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain: for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
controles.livre: Não tomarás em vão o nome do SENHOR teu Deus; porque o SENHOR não dará por inocente ao que tomar em vão seu nome.

versos.hebraico: שָׁמ֛וֹר אֶת־י֥וֹם הַשַׁבָּ֖ת לְקַדְּשׁ֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as Yahweh your God commanded you.
controles.kjv: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee.
controles.livre: Guardarás o dia do repouso para santificá-lo, como o SENHOR teu Deus te mandou.

versos.hebraico: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּֽעֲבֹ֔ד וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ כָּל־מְלַאכְתֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;
controles.kjv: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
controles.livre: Seis dias trabalharás e farás toda tua obra:

versos.hebraico: וְי֨וֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שַׁבָּ֖ת לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כָל־מְלָאכָ֡ה אַתָּ֣ה וּבִנְךָֽ־וּבִתֶּ֣ךָ וְעַבְדְּךָֽ־וַ֠אֲמָתֶךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ֨ וַחֲמֹֽרְךָ֜ וְכָל־בְּהֶמְתֶּ֗ךָ וְגֵֽרְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ לְמַ֗עַן יָנ֛וּחַ עַבְדְּךָ֥ וַאֲמָתְךָ֖ כָּמֽוֹךָ׃

controles.web: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to Yahweh your God, in which you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.
controles.kjv: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
controles.livre: Mas no sétimo é repouso ao SENHOR teu Deus: nenhuma obra farás tu, nem teu filho, nem tua filha, nem teu servo, nem tua serva, nem tua boi, nem tua asno, nem nenhum animal teu, nem tua peregrino que está dentro de tuas portas: para que descanse teu servo e tua serva como

versos.hebraico: וְזָכַרְתָּ֗ כִּ֣י־עֶ֤בֶד הָיִ֨יתָ֙׀ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֹּצִ֨אֲךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָ֖ה וּבִזְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֗ן צִוְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת־י֥וֹם הַשַׁבָּֽת׃ס

controles.web: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and Yahweh your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore Yahweh your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.
controles.kjv: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the Lord thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
controles.livre: E lembra-te que foste servo em terra do Egito, e que o SENHOR teu Deus te tirou dali com mão forte e braço estendido: pelo qual o SENHOR teu Deus te mandou que guardes no dia do repouso.

versos.hebraico: כַּבֵּ֤ד אֶת־אָבִ֨יךָ֙ וְאֶת־אִמֶּ֔ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לְמַ֣עַן׀ יַאֲרִיכֻ֣ן יָמֶ֗יךָ וּלְמַ֨עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ס

controles.web: “Honor your father and your mother, as Yahweh your God commanded you; that your days may be long, and that it may go well with you, in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
controles.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.
controles.livre: Honra a teu pai e a tua mãe, como o SENHOR teu Deus te mandou, para que sejam prolongados teus dias, e para que te vá bem sobre a terra que o SENHOR teu Deus te dá.

versos.hebraico: לֹ֖א תִּרְצָֽח׃ס

controles.web: “You shall not murder.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not kill.
controles.livre: Não cometerás homicídio.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֖א תִּנְאָֽף׃ס

controles.web: “You shall not commit adultery.
controles.kjv: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
controles.livre: Não adulterarás.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֖א תִּגְנֹֽב׃ס

controles.web: “You shall not steal.
controles.kjv: Neither shalt thou steal.
controles.livre: Não furtarás.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־תַעֲנֶ֥ה בְרֵֽעֲךָ֖ עֵ֥ד שָֽׁוְא׃ס

controles.web: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
controles.kjv: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
controles.livre: Não dirás falso testemunho contra teu próximo.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֑ךָס וְלֹ֨א תִתְאַוֶּ֜ה בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֗ךָ שָׂדֵ֜הוּ וְעַבְדּ֤וֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ֙ שׁוֹר֣וֹ וַחֲמֹר֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְרֵעֶֽךָ׃ס

controles.web: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”
controles.kjv: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour’s.
controles.livre: Não cobiçarás a mulher de teu próximo, nem desejarás a casa de teu próximo, nem sua terra, nem seu servo, nem sua serva, nem seu boi, nem seu asno, nem nenhuma coisa que seja de teu próximo.

versos.hebraico: אֶֽת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־כָּל־קְהַלְכֶ֜ם בָּהָ֗ר מִתּ֤וֹךְ הָאֵשׁ֙ הֶֽעָנָ֣ן וְהָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וְלֹ֣א יָסָ֑ף וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֗ם עַל־שְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת אֲבָנִ֔ים וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.
controles.kjv: These words the Lord spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
controles.livre: Estas palavras falou o SENHOR a toda vossa congregação no monte, do meio do fogo, da nuvem e da escuridão, a grande voz: e não acrescentou mais. E escreveu-os em duas tábuas de pedra, as quais deu a mim.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשָׁמְעֲכֶ֤ם אֶת־הַקּוֹל֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַתִּקְרְב֣וּן אֵלַ֔י כָּל־רָאשֵׁ֥י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֖ם וְזִקְנֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: When you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
controles.livre: E aconteceu, que como vós ouvistes a voz do meio das trevas, e vistes ao monte que ardia em fogo, aproximastes a mim todos os príncipes de vossas tribos, e vossos anciãos;

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּאמְר֗וּ הֵ֣ן הֶרְאָ֜נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ֙ אֶת־כְּבֹד֣וֹ וְאֶת־גָּדְל֔וֹ וְאֶת־קֹל֥וֹ שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָאֵ֑שׁ הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ רָאִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־יְדַבֵּ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם וָחָֽי׃

controles.web: and you said, “Behold, Yahweh our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire. We have seen this day that God does speak with man, and he lives.
controles.kjv: And ye said, Behold, the Lord our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
controles.livre: E dissestes: Eis que, o SENHOR nosso Deus nos mostrou sua glória e sua grandeza, e ouvimos sua voz do meio do fogo: hoje vimos que o SENHOR fala ao homem, e este vive.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּה֙ לָ֣מָּה נָמ֔וּת כִּ֣י תֹֽאכְלֵ֔נוּ הָאֵ֥שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את אִם־יֹסְפִ֣ים׀ אֲנַ֗חְנוּ לִ֠שְׁמֹעַ אֶת־ק֨וֹל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ ע֖וֹד וָמָֽתְנוּ׃

controles.web: Now therefore why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the voice of Yahweh our God any more, then we shall die.
controles.kjv: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the Lord our God any more, then we shall die.
controles.livre: Agora pois, por que morreremos? Que este grande fogo nos consumirá: se voltarmos a ouvir a voz do SENHOR nosso Deus, morreremos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י מִ֣י כָל־בָּשָׂ֡ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע קוֹל֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים חַיִּ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־הָאֵ֛שׁ כָּמֹ֖נוּ וַיֶּֽחִי׃

controles.web: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
controles.kjv: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
controles.livre: Porque, que é toda carne, para que ouça a voz do Deus vivente que fala do meio do fogo, como nós a ouvimos, e viva?

versos.hebraico: קְרַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע אֵ֛ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְאַ֣תְּ׀ תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֗ינוּ אֵת֩ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְדַבֵּ֜ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְשָׁמַ֥עְנוּ וְעָשִֽׂינוּ׃

controles.web: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
controles.kjv: Go thou near, and hear all that the Lord our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the Lord our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
controles.livre: Chega tu, e ouve todas as coisas que disser o SENHOR nosso Deus; e tu nos dirás todo o que o SENHOR nosso Deus te disser, e nós ouviremos e faremos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֔ם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י שָׁ֠מַעְתִּי אֶת־ק֨וֹל דִּבְרֵ֜י הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבְּר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃

controles.web: Yahweh heard the voice of your words, when you spoke to me; and Yahweh said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.
controles.kjv: And the Lord heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the Lord said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
controles.livre: E ouviu o SENHOR a voz de vossas palavras, quando me faláveis; e disse-me o SENHOR: Ouvi a voz das palavras deste povo, que eles te falaram: bem está tudo o que disseram.

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־יִתֵּ֡ן וְהָיָה֩ לְבָבָ֨ם זֶ֜ה לָהֶ֗ם לְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י וְלִשְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת־כָּל־מִצְוֺתַ֖י כָּל־הַיָּמִ֑ים לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָהֶ֛ם וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְעֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: Oh that there were such a heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children forever!
controles.kjv: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
controles.livre: Quem dera que tivessem tal coração, que me temessem, e guardassem todos os dias todos meus mandamentos, para que a eles e a seus filhos lhes fosse bem para sempre!

versos.hebraico: לֵ֖ךְ אֱמֹ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם שׁ֥וּבוּ לָכֶ֖ם לְאָהֳלֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
controles.kjv: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
controles.livre: Vai, dize-lhes: Voltai-vos a vossas tendas.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֗ה פֹּה֮ עֲמֹ֣ד עִמָּדִי֒ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ אֵ֧ת כָּל־הַמִּצְוָ֛ה וְהַחֻקִּ֥ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּלַמְּדֵ֑ם וְעָשׂ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will tell you all the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.”
controles.kjv: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
controles.livre: E tu fica aqui comigo, e te direi todos os mandamentos, e estatutos, e regulamentos que lhes hás de ensinar, a fim que os ponham agora por obra na terra que eu lhes dou para possuí-la.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם אֶתְכֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תָסֻ֖רוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאל׃

controles.web: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
controles.kjv: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the Lord your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
controles.livre: Olhai, pois, que façais como o SENHOR vosso Deus vos mandou: não vos desvieis à direita nem à esquerda;

versos.hebraico: בְּכָל־הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם אֶתְכֶ֖ם תֵּלֵ֑כוּ לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיוּן֙ וְט֣וֹב לָכֶ֔ם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּ֣ם יָמִ֔ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּֽירָשֽׁוּן׃

controles.web: You shall walk in all the way which Yahweh your God has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
controles.kjv: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the Lord your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
controles.livre: Andai em todo caminho que o SENHOR vosso Deus vos mandou, para que vivais, e vos vá bem, e tenhais longos dias na terra que haveis de possuir.
